D: A millionaire facing prison hires the man who washes his car to toughen him up before he goes inside.
P: Serve the mains when Darnell starts the training.
S: Crisp baked wings in hot sauce butter, ranch for dipping
Crispy hot wings from the corner, tossed in a buttery hot sauce with ranch on the side.
Warm blinis with chive crème fraîche and salmon roe

Warm blinis with chive crème fraîche, smoked salmon ribbons and glossy salmon roe, a squeeze of lemon and dill, the millionaire's party snack. Warm 16 small blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 150g crème fraîche with 1 tbsp chopped chives and lemon zest. Top each blini with a spoon of the cream, a ribbon of smoked salmon (150g total) and half a teaspoon of salmon roe (50g total). Finish with a tiny dill sprig and a squeeze of lemon and arrange on a platter.
M: Barbecue glazed chicken thighs with mac and cheese and silverbeet
Barbecue chicken thighs with mac and cheese and greens, the family dinner James gets invited to.
James King's Bel Air steak frites
The last fancy dinner King thinks he's getting before San Quentin

Sirloin steaks seared hard and finished with garlic herb butter, with crisp oven fries and a dressed rocket salad. Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the chips in 2 tbsp oil and salt and bake, turning once, until crisp. Mash the butter with the garlic and chopped parsley. Sear the steaks in a very hot pan to your liking, then rest with a slice of herb butter on each. Dress the rocket with lemon and the last of the oil and serve with the steak and chips.
W: Stovetop chocolate pudding chilled in cups

Silky dark chocolate pudding set in cups under salted cookie crumb, whipped cream and chocolate curls, canteen dessert done properly. Whisk 600ml milk, 80g caster sugar, 30g cocoa, 3 tbsp cornflour and a pinch of salt in a saucepan over medium heat until it thickens, about 6 minutes. Off the heat, stir in 80g chopped dark chocolate and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth. Pour into 4 cups, cover the surface and chill 2 hours. Top with whipped cream (150ml), crushed chocolate biscuits (60g) with a pinch of flaky salt and chocolate curls.
K: Tequila, cucumber, lime and jalapeño with a salted rim

Fresh cucumber juice shaken with tequila, lime, agave and a slice of jalapeño, poured over ice in a salt-rimmed glass with cucumber ribbons. Blitz 1 continental cucumber with 50ml water and strain. Rim 4 glasses with lime and salt. For each drink, muddle 2 slices of jalapeño in a shaker, add 45ml tequila, 45ml cucumber juice, 25ml lime juice and 15ml agave, shake with ice and strain over fresh ice. Garnish with a cucumber ribbon. For non-drinkers, top the cucumber, lime and agave with soda instead.

veg.n: Car wash corner store battered onion wings
veg.make_ahead: Cut the onions into petals up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled; the ranch can sit in the fridge as well. Batter, fry and toss just before serving.

steps.text: Peel the onions, cut each into 6 wedges and separate into thick petals.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt with the cold water into a thick batter.
Heat the vegetable oil to 180C in a deep heavy pot.
Dip the onion petals in the batter and fry in batches for 3 minutes until golden, then drain.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce, toss the onion through it and serve with the ranch dressing.

veg.make_ahead: Cook and dress the lentils and slice the beetroot up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; warm the blinis and top to serve

steps.text: Simmer the black lentils in water for 20 minutes until just tender, drain, cool and dress with the soy sauce and a few drops of lemon juice.
Warm the small blinis at 180C for 4 minutes.
Mix the crème fraîche with the chopped chives and lemon zest, and slice the cooked beetroot into thin ribbons.
Top each blini with a spoon of the cream, a ribbon of beetroot and half a teaspoon of the glossy lentils.
Finish with a tiny dill sprig and a squeeze of lemon and arrange on a platter.
